command:
set -eu
printf '%s\n' '== os ==' 
cat /etc/os-release
printf '%s\n' '== pwquality effective files ==' 
rpm -q libpwquality pam 2>/dev/null || true
ls -l /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d 2>/dev/null || true

printf '%s\n' '== boot identity =='

command:
set -eu
umask 022
tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/.99-password-policy.XXXXXX)
printf '%s\n' '# Managed password complexity policy' 'minlen = 12' 'minclass = 3' > "$tmpfile"
chown root:root "$tmpfile"
chmod 0644 "$tmpfile"
mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
restorecon /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '== installed policy =='
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf
cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-password-policy.conf

command:
set +e
check_case() {
  label=$1
  candidate=$2
  chars=$(printf '%s' "$candidate" | wc -c)
  printf '%s\n' "== $label (length=$chars) =="
  result=$(printf '%s\n' "$candidate" | pwscore 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  printf '%s\n' "exit=$rc" "$result"
}

check_case '12 chars, 3 classes: must accept' 'qjvntxplrM27'
exit 0
